7	``` text
8	head/.claude/scripts/lib/dec-write-lib.sh:627 — `import` checks the pending file only with the plain schema validator (no base file, so it never compares against `proposed`), and nothing afterwards limits the imported rows to `open`/`proposed`. A pending file edited by hand to hold a `decided` row with `decided_by: operator`, a `cli:` ref and an `operator:decisions-command` transition gets imported into the live ledger as DEC-0001, decided by the operator. I reproduced this. That gets around the rule that only `/decisions confirm` makes a row `decided`. Pending files are written in linked worktrees by agents, so they are not trusted input. `import` should refuse any row that is not open/proposed, has a non-null `decided_by`, or has a transition past `proposed`.

The PRD keeps that line after the run ends, so while it is there the operator's `--answer-ref cli:…` is dropped with a misleading WARN ("the row stays proposed"). The row is then confirmed with `decided_by: agent` and `decided_by_ref: null`. I reproduced this. Operator confirmations made through `/decisions` are recorded as agent decisions with no way to fix them, because the ledger is append-only.

# Judge item J1837

Rate the finding: `real` (a real defect at head), `style`, `wrong`, or `not-a-finding`.

## Finding

``` text
head/.claude/scripts/lib/dec-write-lib.sh:184 — CRITICAL: `live_run_signal` is `ctx_signals | grep -q` under pipefail; with two or more live signals (fresh unattended marker + RUNNING run state) the producer dies of SIGPIPE, the pipeline returns 141 and the confirm refusal at line 509 never fires (reproduced 5/5: rows moved to decided during a live run).
head/.claude/scripts/lib/dec-write-lib.sh:183 — HIGH: `is_unattended` counts the PRD `**Status:**` line (lines 177-180) as an unattended signal, so with an autonomous PRD the operator's confirm drops its --answer-ref (line 314) and records decided_by agent (line 538), the operator's reject of a decided row dies (line 575), and the operator's supersede takes the agent path (lines 600-611).
head/.claude/scripts/lib/dec-write-lib.sh:251 — HIGH: any `--file` target is classed fixture before the CI/hook check at line 261, so `CI=1 … new --file grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml` writes the live ledger (reproduced), a hook or worktree can write the main ledger by path, and confirm/supersede on a --file pending path escape the refusals at lines 512 and 593.
head/.claude/scripts/lib/dec-write-lib.sh:580 — HIGH: `op_reject` rewrites only the rejected row; rejecting a proposed replacement leaves the predecessor's supersede_proposed_by stale, so every later agent supersede dies at line 601 and the operator's reject of the predecessor aborts in verify_and_swap (reproduced).
head/.claude/scripts/lib/dec-write-lib.sh:647 — HIGH: `import` swaps t …
```
